name: copy
title: Copy
description: A clipboard icon that draws a check when copied, then resets.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels.

props.name: copied
props.description: Controlled copied state. When omitted the icon manages its own state.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with the copied state on change.

props.name: resetDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before an uncontrolled icon resets to the idle state.

accessibility: Renders as a button with an accessible label that updates to "Copied" when the check is shown. Uses aria-live so the state change is announced.
touch: Hover scale is gated behind a (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) check. Tapping triggers the copy-to-check transition directly.
reducedMotion: The check draw is skipped; the check and clipboard crossfade with a short 150ms transition so the state change remains clear.
